selection.selection_rule: Unique uppercase PDB; exact overlap with any official MISATO ID or previous pilot excluded; ten replicas and catalog CC-BY-4.0; lexicographically first accession for duplicate PDB; SHA256 of 42|mdbind-unseen|PDB, ascending; first 50 reserved before decoding trajectories. Prospective precision extension frozen before decoding: retain original fifty confirmation IDs and original six seen IDs; append next thirty SHA256-ranked eligible IDs after these fifty-six. No reselection after QC or outcomes.
